note: Per-platform engine artifacts. The installer ships WITHOUT the ~840MB engine (downloader model) and provisions the entry matching the running build. LOBSTER_ENGINE_URL/LOBSTER_ENGINE_SHA256 override this for testing/self-hosting. A platform with no entry fails provisioning with a clear error rather than downloading another OS's archive.

rebuildPending.why: The repo repinned from 152.0.7928.0 (a CANARY nightly, near-unique in fullVersionList) to the M152 beta-frozen release build. The linux-x64 entry still names the OLD artifact on purpose: version/url/sha256 may only move once a rebuilt tarball actually exists, or first-run provisioning breaks for every user. Until then the installer provisions the previous engine and ENGINE_CHROME claims one patch newer within the same milestone.
rebuildPending.howToClear: On the Linux build host: lobium/rebase.sh 152.0.7977.42 --run && lobium/build.sh --run && scripts/package-lobium-runtime.sh, then `node scripts/bump-engine-version.mjs 152.0.7977.42 --tarball <lobium-linux-x64.tar.gz>` to rewrite version/url/sha256 and drop this block.

win-x64Pending.why: The prior Windows 152.0.7977.42 official/PGO/ThinLTO binary predates the current patch series and capability-contract v3, so the launcher correctly refuses it. No win-x64 entry is listed because publishing that stale binary would silently omit current native protections, while naming an artifact that does not exist would make first-run provisioning fail after a large download.
win-x64Pending.howToClear: On the Windows build host: force-clean the exact 152.0.7977.42 checkout, rerun lobium/build.ps1 with official/PGO/ThinLTO settings, and pass the capability and real-browser gates. Obtain a separately verified production font pack following docs/OPERATIONS.md; a no-pack runtime is local/degraded only and must not be published. Require exact declared-versus-scanned family sets with an explicit reviewed fc-scan executable, and require each persona to include every family exposed by any selected multi-family TTC. Package with explicit -SourceDir, -FontPack <verified-font-pack>, -FontScanner <fc-scan.exe>, and the new versioned -OutDir dist-win/lobium-runtime-152.0.7977.42 (refuse it if it already exists), verify that exact tree with scripts/verify-lobium-runtime.mjs --font-scanner <fc-scan.exe>, compress only that directory to the new archive dist-win/lobium-win-x64-152.0.7977.42.zip, extract into a new verification directory, and repeat the artifact ledger, physical font-family scan, and executable version/capability probes. Upload the verified archive, download its final public URL and require the same SHA-256, then run `node scripts/bump-engine-version.mjs 152.0.7977.42 --platform win-x64 --archive dist-win/lobium-win-x64-152.0.7977.42.zip --url <published-url>`.
